summary: Backend regression after removing the 3-team cap on athletes. 23/23 pytest cases pass. Confirmed the cap is gone on both POST and PATCH /api/athletes (4 / 8 / 10 team_ids all return 200). All iteration_16 Phase B scenarios continue to pass: Teams CRUD, team-delete cascade ($pull from athletes.team_ids + competitions.team_ids + competitions.team_meet_times), Competition round-trip of team_ids/team_meet_times/teams_to_watch, POST /api/competitions with omitted list fields (the iter-16 create_competition exclude_none fix still holds), bulk-delete for teams/expenses/payments/fundraisers/schedule_events/competitions, role persistence on POST + PATCH athletes, and /api/auth/me.
action_items: None required for this iteration. Cap-removal change is clean. Frontend ColorField swap and athlete-form cap-warning removal not tested per request (backend-only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 3192 lines - same long-file callout as iteration_16 still applies, but no new churn this pass.

POST /api/athletes and PATCH /api/athletes/{id} now have no upper bound on team_ids length. If product ever wants a soft cap (e.g. 20) for runaway-payload protection, it would have to be added explicitly. Currently 10-team and 8-team payloads work fine and persist intact.
